[[File:PT ABD Dragapult without Dreepy.png|thumb|250px|Blossom's parents]] '''Blossom's parents''' are a duo of characters that appeared in ''[[PT03|Blossom's Dream]]'', the third episode of the [[POKÉTOON]] animated shorts. In the past, the two were [[Pokémon Trainer]]s who participated in the [[Galar League]]. Sometime after birth, {{OBP|Blossom|POKÉTOON}} loved watching her father's battle videos. This inspired Blossom to become a Pokémon Trainer too, and some time later, she decided it was time to go out on a journey. While her father approved of this, her mother believed it was still not the right time. During an incident involving a family of {{p|Nidoqueen}} and {{p|Nidoking}}, Blossom's parents finally realized that their daughter had achieved the necessary maturity to become a Pokémon Trainer. A few days passed and Blossom set out on her own journey, and her parents remembered the moment that defined their lives; the battle where the mother defeated her future husband in a [[Pokémon battle]] in competition. ==Pokémon== ===Father=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Blossom's father |nick=Char-ly |pkmn=Charizard |type1=Fire |type2=Flying |img=Blossom Char-ly.png |cap=Char-ly |epnum=PT03 |epname=Blossom's Dream |vajp=Tsuguo Mogami |vaen=Zack Sage |desc='''Char-ly''' (Japanese: '''ちょろび''' ''Chorobi'') is Blossom's father's {{p|Charizard}}. When Blossom's father was younger, he used it to compete in the [[Galar League]], but they were eventually defeated by a female Trainer and her {{p|Dragapult}}. This female Trainer would later on become Blossom's mother. In the present, Char-ly lived with Blossom and her parents. It had grown old and mostly spent its days sleeping in the garden. When a fight broke out between a wild {{p|Nidoking}} and {{p|Nidoqueen}} and a couple of local Trainers, Blossom called upon Char-ly to help out. Riding and commanding Char-ly, Blossom managed to settle the conflict. Blossom's parents were impressed with her handling of Char-ly and allowed her to leave on her own journey. Char-ly later watched as Blossom left town. Char-ly's known moves are {{m|Flamethrower}}, {{m|Fly}}{{tt|*|mentioned only}}, and {{m|Fire Blast}}.}} ===Mother=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Blossom's mother |pkmn=Dragapult |type1=Dragon |type2=Ghost |img=PT ABD Dragapult without Dreepy.png |cap=Blossom's mother's Dragapult |epnum=PT03 |epname=Blossom's Dream |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Dragapult}} is Blossom's mother's only known Pokémon. In the past, it was used in a battle against the man who would later become her husband and Blossom's father. This victory allowed the young woman to move to the next round of the [[Galar League]]. In the present, Dragapult appeared alongside its Trainer when Blossom finally got her parents' approval to go on a Pokémon journey.
